metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘Surprise! You’re a sniper now’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just steal a kill outta nowhere?
Enemy probably AFK or just confused.
Click if your aim’s a mystery but the game still gifts you moments like this.
Valorant logic doing its weird magic again.

Tap if your best plays come from pure chaos!

#valorant #luckshot #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
